name: Say the Spire 2
description: Screen-reader accessibility for Slay the Spire 2: speaks menus, cards, combat, the map, and events, with full keyboard navigation.

requires.onMissing: Please launch Slay the Spire 2 once to generate your settings file, then close it and retry. You can also skip this step and enable mods manually in the game settings.

checks.message: The archive didn't contain the mod (no mods/SayTheSpire2.dll).

settings.note: Restart the game for changes to take effect.

entries.label: Screen reader support
entries.description: Enables text-to-speech announcements and keyboard navigation for blind players. If you are sighted and playing with blind players, turn this off.

entries.label: Disable Godot's built-in UIA accessibility
entries.description: Recommended. Godot's built-in accessibility conflicts with the mod's screen reader. Only turn this off if you use other accessibility tools that rely on UIA.

actions.label: Install JAWS config
actions.description: Copies the mod's JAWS configuration files into your JAWS settings folder.
